subject.title: [Feature]: `session-memory` hook does not comply with AGENTS.md workspace directory convention

question: Should the bundled `session-memory` hook gain a public configurable output path/filename contract, and if so what exact scope is approved for the first implementation?
rationale: The source-reproducible gap remains, but adding path and filename templates expands public hook configuration and filesystem behavior, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive and product-owned.

options.title: Approve a narrow outputDir contract
options.body: Add one workspace-relative, root-validated `outputDir` option while keeping the existing filename format and collision behavior unchanged.

options.title: Approve full path and filename templates
options.body: Support output path and filename templates only after specifying allowed tokens, validation, collision rules, docs, and tests for upgrade/fresh-install behavior.

options.title: Keep the hook fixed for now
options.body: Leave `session-memory` at the fixed memory layout and steer users toward documented memory-search guidance or a future plugin-level memory artifact surface.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow outputDir contract
recommendation.body: Add one workspace-relative, root-validated `outputDir` option while keeping the existing filename format and collision behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent path history shows the most direct current-main work on session-memory filename behavior and docs.
